basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old university student from Sydney, Australia, studying computer science. I've always been a fan of video games, especially team-based shooters like Team Fortress 2. I stumbled upon Reddit while looking for advice on upgrading my Subaru Crosstrek and quickly got hooked on various communities. When I'm not studying or gaming, I enjoy reading Polish literature and exploring new business ideas. My typical online hours are in the evening, after classes and assignments. I'm currently single, focusing on my studies and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, being in the final year of my undergraduate degree. My knowledge comes from both formal education and self-teaching through online courses and tutorials. I'm also an avid reader of business and technology books, which fuels my interest in starting my own venture someday.
